userStories.title: P9.2 Chat: channel/thread summarization + catch-me-up tools (read-only, caller-permission-scoped)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the assistant to be able to read an authorized channel's recent messages and my unread backlog so that it can summarize threads and catch me up.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat: channel/thread summarization, catch-me-up (PLAN.md P9.2 bullet, copied verbatim).

Two new a2e-chat logic functions with toolTriggerSettings (native registry via P1.5; no registerAiTools, no new table), handlers extracted under src/logic-functions/handlers/ per the existing a2e-chat precedent.

summarize-channel: input channelId (+ optional threadParentId and maxMessages); returns authorized recent messages (id, author name, createdAt, body) + participant/emoji-reaction stats as typed data for the assistant to summarize. PRIVATE channels: the tool must fail closed with a typed denial when the caller cannot read the channel — the coreClient read runs under the caller's auth context; add an explicit membership/readability assert as defense in depth.

catch-me-up: input channelId (+ optional sinceIso); default window = messages after the caller's readCursor for that channel (readCursor is the a2e-chat object from P5.1); returns the unread messages payload.
Both tools are strictly read-only — no message/reaction/cursor writes (C6).

Unit tests (a2e-chat yarn test:unit): happy-path payload shape; private-channel denial for a non-member; empty channel → empty payload with implemented status; input validation; threadParentId scoping.

userStories.title: P9.2 Projects: standup digest from activity + task-breakdown context tools (read-only)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the assistant to assemble a standup digest from recent activity and to see a project's task structure so that it can propose breakdowns and updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Projects: task breakdown suggestions, standup digest from activity (PLAN.md P9.2 bullet, copied verbatim).
Two new a2e-projects logic functions with toolTriggerSettings (native registry via P1.5; no registerAiTools, no new table), handlers under src/logic-functions/handlers/.

standup-digest: input optional sinceIso (default: previous local day) and optional projectId; returns a typed digest payload — tasks completed in the window, tasks updated/created in the window, overdue open tasks (dueAt < now, not done) — assembled from project/task data read under the caller's auth context.

task-breakdown-context: input projectId; returns the project's task tree (roots + children via the parentTask relation), milestones with dueAt/doneAt, and status counts — the context the assistant needs to PROPOSE a breakdown.
